trigger_condition.state_trigger: Serialized object contains torch.nn.Parameter attributes, including nested module parameters.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.save serializes a torch.nn.Module, then torch.load restores it and Parameter attributes are materialized as torch.Tensor.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: The saved object must be a torch.nn.Module containing torch.nn.Parameter attributes; torch.load is used for deserialization.

bug_oracle.description: After torch.load, attributes that were torch.nn.Parameter before saving are returned as torch.Tensor instances, losing their original semantic type.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate module structures by varying parameter placement, nesting depth, parameter names, shapes, dtypes, and requires_grad values.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct torch.nn.Module subclasses with torch.nn.Parameter attributes at top level and inside nested modules.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject framework-specific state wrappers such as torch.nn.Parameter into otherwise ordinary tensor attributes before serialization.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Serialize the constructed module with torch.save, deserialize with torch.load, and inspect the type of each restored parameter-bearing attribute.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Assert that every attribute that was torch.nn.Parameter before torch.save remains isinstance(attr, torch.nn.Parameter) after torch.load, and verify requires_grad and tensor values match.
